title: claude  -  replay of a real session (condensed)  -  godot-claude-kit
prompt: I refactored the server-side hit validation in src/net/net_match.gd. Make sure multiplayer still works for real - a server and a client actually talking, not just compiling. Don't change any code. Reply in English, briefly. The Godot binary is in GODOT_BIN.

events.text: ⏺ A harness already exists. Running it plus the static RPC check.
net:     res://tools/netdiag_hits.tscn, server + 1 client(s) on 127.0.0.1:47461, logs _netlogs
FAIL  server applied exactly the valid hits (hp=0)
GODOT-RUN: FAIL (engine exit 1; FAIL line in log; banner /^NETDIAG-HITS-SERVER: PASS/ missing)
ok    server synced hp after a valid hit
FAIL  oversized hit refused (only the 1 landed) (synced=[70, 0, 0] lost=false)
GODOT-RUN: FAIL (engine exit 1; FAIL line in log; banner /^NETDIAG-HITS-CLIENT: PASS/ missing)
RPC-CHECK: PASS - 5 rpc call(s), all land on one of 3 @rpc functions
⏺ The run fails, and the failure looks real. Reading the code to find the cause:

⏺ Multiplayer does not work correctly after the refactor. I ran a real headless server and client as separate engine processes on 127.0.0.1 and they connected and exchanged RPCs, but the hit validation fails. I changed no code.
- Client: it received synced=[70, 0, 0], but [70, 69] was expected. The 9999 hit was accepted and killed the target.
Cause: src/net/net_match.gd:41 only refuses amount < 1. The upper bound against MAX_HIT (50) was lost in the refactor, so a client can send any damage it likes.
